messages:
Lina (Support): Customer says they started getting 403s this morning, message: \"invalid API key\" but they're certain key is valid. They just upgraded the account yesterday.
Marta (Billing): Which account / org? Any plan change id?
Lina (Support): ACME Corp / org_12987. Upgrade completed by billing job id bjob-887. Customer says SDK call works for a short while then 403s.
Lina (Support): Quick repro they pasted: 
```bash
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/respond\" -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-small\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'
```
Lina (Support): Response: `\{\"error\":\{\"code\":403,\"message\":\"invalid api key\"\}\}`
Carlos (Eng): Hmm, often that message surface is overloaded. Could be entitlement gating returning a 403 with auth-like wording. Did we log entitlement checks?
Lina (Support): I grabbed the logs from the proxy: `ent_check=failed reason=plan_not_active sku_missing`. But token validation passed earlier in trace.
entitlement-bot: entitlement-check org_12987 -> sku: premium_chat -> STATUS: MISSING
Carlos (Eng): There we go. Billing updated but the SKU sync lagged or the feature-flag mapping didn't flip. Platform currently maps missing SKU -> 403 with `invalid api key` text for legacy reasons.
Marta (Billing): On our side the invoice finalized at 09:12 UTC, license record created 09:15 UTC. Sync job to control plane runs every 10m; maybe customer hit it between creation and sync.
Lina (Support): Customer timeline: upgrade at 09:14, first successful request 09:16, then 403s starting 09:22. So falls within race window.
Carlos (Eng): Action items: 1) Support: confirm this is the race not actual token revocation. 2) Billing: forward to ops to bump sync frequency for invoice->entitlement mapping for manual upgrades. 3) Eng: file bug to make error message distinct (403 + code=ENTITLEMENT_MISSING) and include `entitlement_hint` in response. 4) Short-term workaround: mark org as provisioned in control plane manual sync.
Lina (Support): I'll tell customer: \"Looks like entitlement sync lag. Your key isn't revoked. We can manually provision now or wait up to 10m. We'll also add a safer error so it's not confused with auth failures.\" :thumbsup:
Carlos (Eng): For repro: run the curl, then in logs look for `ent_check=...` and `token_ok=true` in same trace id. Example log snippet: 
````
TRACE 2026-03-12T09:22:08Z id=tr_42 token_ok=true ent_check=failed(plan_not_active)
````
Carlos (Eng): Also add this to incident template: if 403 and token_ok=true -> check entitlement-bot and billing sync timestamps before escalating as auth.
Marta (Billing): I'll also add a monitoring alert: increase severity if many orgs hit 'sku_missing' after an invoice.
Lina (Support): Customer updated: happy to wait 10m but wants root cause and a follow-up. I've scheduled a follow-up note and will close after confirmation.
Carlos (Eng): Created ENG-11429 to change response body and add `error.subcode=ENTITLEMENT_MISSING`. Assign to me for a first pass.
Lina (Support): Thanks all — closing loop with customer now.
Marta (Billing): Follow-up: I synced the org manually at 09:25, customer confirmed requests succeeded at 09:26.
Lina (Support): Closing note to customer: \"This was a timing issue between billing finalization and entitlement sync. Your API key was never revoked. We provisioned access and will push a fix to make the error clearer so you don't see `invalid api key` in this case.\" :white_check_mark:
